dct_description_sm:
Mapping depicts Brampton Schedule “10” identifies areas where Secondary Plans have been prepared or may be prepared in the future.

Secondary Planning Areas identify the geographic areas within Brampton that are subject to Secondary Plans, which provide more detailed land use, urban design, transportation, infrastructure, and community planning policies than those contained in the Official Plan. These areas guide the coordinated development, redevelopment, and long-term growth of specific communities and districts while implementing the broader vision and objectives of Brampton Plan.

This data is intended to be used in conjuction with other related mapping layers for this schedule, and may be impacted by other schedules, with consideration to the text of Brampton Plan.
